name: skewed-heavy-hitter-analytics
description: Deterministic 80% hot-user traffic, dominant dimensions, sparse nullable promos and large-revenue outliers

queries.name: top-20-customers-by-events
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY 2 DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 20

queries.name: top-20-customers-by-spend
queries.sql: SELECT user_id, SUM(amount) AS spend, COUNT(amount) AS events FROM events GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY spend DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT 20

queries.name: regional-revenue-and-orders
queries.sql: SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(amount) AS orders FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC

queries.name: category-revenue-top-3
queries.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

queries.name: multi-dimensional-region-category-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, SUM(amount), COUNT(amount), MAX(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category

queries.name: multi-dimensional-top-10-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, SUM(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY 3 DESC, region, category LIMIT 10

queries.name: unique-customers-by-region
queries.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

queries.name: unique-customers-by-region-and-category
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category

queries.name: paid-revenue-overview
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount), AVG(amount), MIN(amount), MAX(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events WHERE status = 'paid'

queries.name: nullable-promo-segment-metrics
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, AVG(amount), MAX(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events WHERE coupon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category

queries.name: top-paid-categories
queries.sql: SELECT category, SUM(amount), COUNT(amount) FROM events WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY category ORDER BY 2 DESC, category ASC LIMIT 3

queries.name: dimension-cardinality-having
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY region, category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) > 10 ORDER BY region, category
